comment: models = the default chain (gemma-4-31b free: best tps of the smart free models). paid_models = tier:paid (gpt-5-nano: budget paid, $0.05/M in $0.40/M out). judge_models = the survey judge chain (owl-alpha first so judging never eats the planners' gemma quota). presets = named chains for ti.py run --preset; edit freely.

preset_notes.gemma: default: smart free model with the best tps
preset_notes.nemotron-ultra: very smart free model but ~7 tps - SLOW, overnight only
